name: Selerix
summary: Selerix sells BenSelect, a benefits administration platform for enrollment, eligibility and carrier connections. Its integrations page describes a library of established file feeds plus API integrations, and a partner network that it shows with 24 logos. It also tracks variable-hour eligibility for ACA with measurement and stability period logic. No prices are published, and the site points buyers to a demo request.

facts.text: The integrations page describes an expansive library of established file feeds to simplify setup, and says its API integrations are an alternative to manual feeds.
The ACA page says Selerix automates variable-hour eligibility tracking using measurement and stability period logic.
The benefits administration page says the platform handles varied contribution structures, multiple populations and unique pay cycles, and that it has completed a SOC 2 audit.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: No prices published. The site directs buyers to talk to an expert and request a live demo
